exposure: bile acid (BA) metabolism profiles in urine
specific urinary bile acids (THCA, TCA, T-o-MCA, TCA-3-S, TCDCA-3-S, TDCA-3-S, GCDCA-3-S, DCA-3-G, GDCA-3-G)
outcome: gestational weeks at time of ICP diagnosis
duration of using ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA) drugs during pregnancy
cohort: The study included 127 Chinese women with Intrahepatic Cholestasis of Pregnancy (ICP) and 55 healthy pregnant women, whose spot urine samples and clinical data were collected from January 2019 to December 2022 at the First Affiliated Hospital of Chongqing Medical University.
finding: Maternal urinary bile acid profiles are prominent for predicting maternal and neonatal outcomes of ICP, with elevated levels of TCA-3-S, TCDCA-3-S, and GCDCA-3-S serving as important predictors for adverse pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: Significant differences in cesarean delivery rates were observed between mild and severe ICP groups.
cross-section timing: Data was collected retrospectively from January 2019 to December 2022.
